key.name: light-style
key.description: Whether the glass, the panel and GNOME's menus turn light while GNOME's dark style is off. Off: always dark, prefer-light included.

key.name: accent-tint
key.description: Whether GNOME's accent colour is mixed into the glass's tint.

key.name: accent-amount
key.description: How much of the accent colour is mixed into the tint, in per cent.

key.name: dark-depth
key.description: The opacity of the dark tint over the blurred wallpaper, in per cent.

key.name: light-depth
key.description: The opacity of the light tint over the blurred wallpaper, in per cent.
